works.author: Bogdan Nikitin for Nixtio
works.comment: 换币流程的视觉层级做得非常利落，深色系的动线引导值得抄。
works.comment_en: The token-swap flow's visual hierarchy is razor-sharp — the dark-theme flow guidance is worth stealing.
works.title: Crypto Trading & Token Swap Mobile App

works.author: Imran Hossen
works.comment: 柔和插画+大呼吸感留白，把"治愈感"做进版式节奏里。
works.comment_en: Soft illustrations plus big, breathable whitespace — the 'healing' feeling is baked into the layout rhythm.
works.title: Mental Health Website | AI Mental Wellness Platform

works.author: Mahid
works.comment: 数据仪表盘直接做进落地页首屏，信任感拉满的 SaaS 范式。
works.comment_en: The data dashboard sits right in the landing page's first screen — a trust-maximizing SaaS pattern.
works.title: Fintech Landing Page Design

works.author: Eloqwnt
works.comment: 预测类产品的仪表盘信息密度和配色对比处理得很克制。
works.comment_en: Prediction-product dashboard with restrained info density and color contrast.
works.title: AI-Powered Launch Predictor Platform

works.author: Topnotch UI/UX for Topnotch Studio
works.comment: 键盘产品页的特写镜头+参数排版，DTC 产品叙事感很强。
works.comment_en: Keyboard product page: macro shots plus spec typography — strong DTC product storytelling.
works.title: Keyboard E-commerce Website Design
